originalTitle: Verizon posts worst day since 2002 as SpaceX U.S. network plans whack cell provider stocks
summary: SpaceX announced the spectrum deal Thursday, as the company aims to push deeper into the telecom market through its Starlink service.
content:
Telecommunications stocks sold off on Friday after Elon Musk 's SpaceX announced an agreement to purchase a nationwide spectrum portfolio , aiming to expand its Starlink internet into mobile service.

Verizon closed down 8.75% on the news, its worst day since July 2002. Shares of T-Mobile dropped 13.27% while AT&T fell 9.81%, each notching their own worst days since 2013 and 2000, respectively.

SpaceX stock climbed slightly, around 1% for the day.

The deal includes acquiring the spectrum from Grain Management, which SpaceX described as a "license portfolio of up to 14 megahertz of paired spectrum in the 800 MHz band," in a Thursday statement.

FCC Chair Brendan Carr, whose agency will oversee approval of the deal, said that competition in the spectrum market was "really good news for the American consumers" in a CNBC interview.

"We're probably going to bring over $100 billion of spectrum into the market over the next two years, so we're seeing a lot of competition," Carr told CNBC's " Squawk on the Street " on Friday.

"There's going to be moves in the market. People are going to try to out-compete, out-innovate, and I think that's great. We're going to see how this plays out. It's not for us ultimately to pick winners and losers," he added.

Multiple SpaceX analysts lauded the new spectrum deal, with Evercore ISI writing that the rocket maker "now has the outline of a real network" alongside its existing satellite capabilities. JPMorgan wrote that the acquisition made Starlink Mobile's long-term opportunity "more credible."

"That said, we continue to see limited near-term risk to U.S. wireless incumbents given the time, infrastructure and capital required to build a competitive terrestrial network," analysts added in a Friday note.
chineseTitle: Verizon 遭遇 2002 年以来最糟糕的一天，SpaceX 美国网络计划重创手机提供商股票
chineseSummary: SpaceX 周四宣布了这项频谱协议，该公司旨在通过其 Starlink 服务进一步进军电信市场。
chineseContent:
周五，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 宣布达成协议购买全国范围的频谱组合，旨在将其星链互联网扩展到移动服务后，电信股遭到抛售。

受此消息影响，Verizon 收盘下跌 8.75%，这是自 2002 年 7 月以来最糟糕的一天。T-Mobile 股价下跌 13.27%，AT&T 股价下跌 9.81%，分别创下自 2013 年和 2000 年以来最糟糕的一天。

SpaceX 股价小幅上涨，当日上涨约 1%。

该交易包括从 Grain Management 收购频谱，SpaceX 在周四的一份声明中将其描述为“800 MHz 频段内高达 14 兆赫的配对频谱的许可组合”。

FCC 主席布伦丹·卡尔 (Brendan Carr) 负责监督该交易的批准，他在接受 CNBC 采访时表示，频谱市场的竞争“对美国消费者来说确实是个好消息”。

卡尔周五在 CNBC 的“Squawk on the Street”节目中表示：“未来两年，我们可能会将价值超过 1000 亿美元的频谱引入市场，因此我们会看到激烈的竞争。”

“市场将会发生变化。人们会试图在竞争中胜出，在创新上胜出，我认为这很好。我们将看看结果如何。最终，我们不应该选择赢家和输家，”他补充道。

多位 SpaceX 分析师对这项新的频谱协议表示赞赏，Evercore ISI 写道，除了现有的卫星能力外，火箭制造商“现在已经有了一个真正的网络轮廓”。摩根大通写道，此次收购使 Starlink Mobile 的长期机会“更加可信”。

分析师在周五的一份报告中补充道：“尽管如此，鉴于建立有竞争力的地面网络所需的时间、基础设施和资金，我们仍然认为美国无线现有企业面临的近期风险有限。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
